No. 3 of 2022
AN ACT to amend the Insurance Act, Cap. 12.08.
[ 21st February, 2022 ]
BE IT ENACTED by the Queen’s Most Excellent Majesty, by
and with the advice and consent of the House of Assembly and the
Senate of Saint Lucia, and by the authority of the same, as follows:

20
No. 3] Insurance (Amendment) Act [ 2022
Short title
1. This Act may be cited as the Insurance (Amendment) Act, 2022.
Interpretation
2. In this Act, “principal Act” means the Insurance Act, Cap.
12.08.
Amendment of section 26
3. Section 26 of the principal Act is amended —
(a) in subsection (1), by deleting the words “or within such
extended period not exceeding 2 months as the Registrar
may allow,”;
(b) by inserting immediately after subsection (1) the following
new subsection (1A) —
“(1A) Notwithstanding subsection (1), the Registrar may
extend the period for a company to submit the documents
specified under subsection (1) for a period of two months
or such further period which he or she considers reasonable
where —
(a) the Governor General by proclamation under section
17 of the Constitution of Saint Lucia, Cap. 1.01
declares that a state of emergency exists; or
(b) the Minister responsible for disaster management
declares that a disaster exists under section 18 of the
Disaster Management Act, Cap. 14.06.”.
Amendment of section 57
4. Section 57 of the principal Act is amended by deleting the
words “or within such extended period not exceeding 2 months as
the Registrar may allow”.

21
No. 3] Insurance (Amendment) Act [ 2022
Insertion of new section 57A
5. The principal Act is amended by inserting immediately after
section 57 the following new section 57A —
“Extension of time under section 57
57A. The Registrar may extend the period for a registered
association to submit the documents specified under section
57 for a period of two months or such further period which
he or she considers reasonable where —
(a) the Governor General by proclamation under section 17
of the Constitution of Saint Lucia, Cap. 1.01 declares
that a state of emergency exists; or
(b) the Minister responsible for disaster management declares
that a disaster exists under section 18 of the Disaster
Management Act, Cap. 14.06.”.
Passed in the House of Assembly this 1st day of February, 2022.
CLAUDIUS J. FRANCIS,
Speaker of the House of Assembly.
Passed in the Senate this 4th day of February, 2022.
STANLEY FELIX,
President of the Senate.
